description: Edges: one-shot evaluations at the ends of each library's domain, every probe through every library in its native representation, against mpmath at 200 digits. See methodology.

versions.maker: dss pot.sol rpow via solady v0.1.26

methodology.truth: Every probe is one op evaluated once. The truth is mpmath at 200 decimal digits from the exact arguments; truthFormat is the same op from the arguments as the representation holds them (floored on a grid, nearest for binary128), so digitsFormat measures the op alone and digits what a caller sees.
methodology.digits: digits = floor(-log10 |v - t| / |t|), capped at 100 (reported as exact); errUlps is the signed error in units of the representation's last place (none for the floats).
methodology.zero: A cell is marked zero when the library returned 0 and the truth is not 0: the result fell below the representation's floor. On an 18-decimal grid that is anything below 1e-18; on FP127's, below 2^-128.
methodology.reverted: A revert is recorded with its selector and name. Unsupported means the library has no way to compute the op (the accrual libraries have no general ops; only FP127 and FP256 have the secondary Lambert branch; the libraries without erf, erfc or normCdf run the same series and continued fraction through their own ops instead, so those cells are not Unsupported).
methodology.range: RANGE means the argument does not fit the representation at all (above 2^127 for FP127, 2^63 for 64.64, 2^128 as a bit pattern for binary128; FP256 holds every probe) and nothing was called.
methodology.gas: gas is measured inside the adapter around the op, after the adapter and the FP127 object are warm. The FP127 (deployed) form includes the staticcall; the others are internal calls.
methodology.live: EdgeRunner.run(op, form, args) on Sepolia evaluates any cell with one eth_call and returns (ok, raw, reason, gas); scripts/ladder/liveedges.py sends every probe's encoded arguments and compares the raw word bit for bit.
methodology.reproduce: make edges regenerates edges.json and edges.md from test/ladder/Edges.t.sol and this script; make edges-check fails CI when the committed dataset differs.
